purpose: Map camera model and scan-type metadata to GPIO connector variants used by Orange config inference.

source_documents.title: Emergent Camera Families and Model Prefixes

notes: This file mixes vendor-backed connector facts with repo-local model inference.
Explicit camera_scan_type and gpio_connector_variant values in config should override inference.
Repo-local model mappings reflect currently supported models in orange-jeremy, not a complete EVT catalog.

vendor_backed_rules.basis: Official EVT camera family naming uses these prefixes for area-scan families.
Official EVT camera family naming uses these prefixes for line-scan families.
Official GPIO docs list a 12-pin connector for line-scan cameras.
Official GPIO docs list a 12-pin connector for area-scan cameras in the general case.
Official HE (Eros) accessory docs show the M8 8-pin GPIO breakout used by HE/Eros cameras.
Official HE (Eros) accessory docs show the M8 8-pin GPIO breakout used by Eros cameras.

runtime_inference_order: Use explicit camera_scan_type from config if it is set and supported.
Use explicit gpio_connector_variant from config if it is set and supported.
If device_model matches a repo_supported_model_override, apply that scan type and connector.
If camera_scan_type is line_scan and connector is still unknown, infer line_scan_12_pin.
If camera_scan_type is area_scan and connector is still unknown, infer area_scan_12_pin.
